title: Environment-aware configuration for a file sync service
name: Sync service config

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code chooses settings for different environments? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The service is deployed to a new cluster where the operator forgets to set APP_ENV. What happens at startup?
choices: It starts in LOCAL mode with debug endpoints and TLS verification disabled
It starts in PRODUCTION mode because that is the safest default
It prints an error and exits with status 78, since Environment.parse throws a ConfigException
It starts with an empty configuration and fails on the first request

questions.prompt: In STAGING, STORAGE_ENDPOINT is not set but STORAGE_BUCKET and KMS_KEY_ID are. What is the resulting storage configuration?
choices: Startup fails because an endpoint is required outside LOCAL
The endpoint falls back to http://localhost:9000
The endpoint is the empty string, and requests fail at runtime
The endpoint is null, which leaves the storage client to use its default service endpoint, with TLS verification enabled and virtual-host style access

questions.prompt: An operator sets SYNC_POLL_SECONDS="fast" in PRODUCTION. What happens at startup?
choices: The value is ignored and the production default of 30 seconds is used
A ConfigException is thrown by the integer helper, main() prints it and the process exits with status 78
A NumberFormatException escapes and the JVM crashes with a stack trace
The value is clamped to the nearest valid interval
